Four compact strength days keep the best training attention on Back Squat and One-Arm Pull-up, keep strict Overhead Press moving with a real but controlled weekly dose, and hold marathon work to one easy Long run so MMA quality stays protected.

The long run is held at the tolerated dose.

If elbows or biceps tendon get cranky, make Monday One-Arm Pull-up all singles and add a little help on Tuesday. If squat depth or speed drops, repeat the last clean squat load and cut the final back-off. If the Thursday Long run hurts Friday sport or Monday squats, shorten it by 2 km and keep it easy.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	Bodyweight	2	30-45 sec	30 sec	2	Then 2-3 ramp sets for One-Arm Pull-up, Back Squat and Push Press.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 70 kg x 5, 105 kg x 3, 137.5 kg x 1-2 before 175 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Mon	One-Arm Pull-up	Bodyweight	3	1-2 per arm	150-240 sec	8	Weaker arm first. First set may earn 2 per arm only if rep 1 is crisp; otherwise make all 3 sets singles per arm and stop before twist or shoulder drop. Week 1 standard: establish the benchmark - every single starts from a dead hang, no kip or swing, and you finish each side with at least one clean rep still in reserve. Record how each side felt; this is the standard Weeks 2-3 have to beat.	
Mon	Back Squat	175 kg	1	3	3-5 min	7.5-8	Compact heavy exposure. If this triple goes above the cap or depth or speed slips, repeat this load next week and cap back-offs at 1 set.	
Mon	Back Squat	167.5 kg	2	3	3-4 min	7	Back-offs are a ceiling, not an obligation; stop after 1 set if the top set already hit the effort cap or bar speed clearly fell.	
Mon	Push Press	RPE-selected load	3	3	2-3 min	7	Secondary vertical-press overload. Keep every rep snappy; no grinders and no missed lockouts.	
Mon	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	10 per side	45-60 sec	6	Trunk stiffness for bracing and grappling; controlled exhale each rep.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	Bodyweight	2	30-45 sec	30 sec	2	Then 2 ramp sets for Assisted One-Arm Pull-up and Back Squat.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 57.5 kg x 5, 87.5 kg x 3, 112.5 kg x 1-2 before 145 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Assisted One-Arm Pull-up	RPE-selected minimal assistance	2	1 per arm	120-180 sec	6-6.5	Easy-skill exposure. Use the minimum help that keeps clean symmetrical reps on each side; if shape breaks, add help rather than forcing it. Recovery-first pulling microdose: technical adjacent-day exposure only, keep it at RPE 6-6.5 or easier and stop well before local fatigue.	
Tue	Ring Push-up	RPE-selected load	1	6-8	90 sec	7	Keep the rings stable, body rigid, and stop 1-2 reps before form breaks.	
Tue	Ring Hamstring Curl	Bodyweight	2	8	60-90 sec	7	Keep hips extended and curl the heels toward you under control; shorten the lever if needed.	
Tue	Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	2	12	45-60 sec	7	Pause at the top and use full stretch for lower-leg tissue capacity.	
Thu	Run	Easy conversational pace	1	18 km	N/A	5-6	Long run. Keep it clearly below first threshold and separate it from MMA by several hours; if it hurts Friday sport or Monday squats, shorten by 2 km before making it faster.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Bodyweight	2	15	30 sec	2	Low-cost support day. Keep the whole gym session crisp and cut the last row first if Friday MMA is especially hard.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Fri	Back Squat	145 kg	2	5	2-3 min	6-6.5	Lower-cost specificity exposure. Smooth reps only; if Monday is still in the legs, keep the same load and make set quality the win.	
Fri	Chin-up	RPE-selected load	1	4	2-3 min	7	sets of 4 quality bilateral support set only. Hold this load if elbows or grip are not crisp; do not turn this into a max day.	
Fri	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	6	90-120 sec	7	Posterior-chain support with low axial cost; full lockout, no grind.	
Fri	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	1	8	60-90 sec	7	One strict support set only; keep torso still and leave 1-2 reps in reserve.	
Fri	Neck Isometric	Bodyweight	2	20-30 sec each position	30-45 sec	6	Flexion, extension and each side. First row to remove if time or recovery gets tight.	
Sun	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Bodyweight	2	15	30 sec	2	Then 3-4 ramp sets for Overhead Press.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Overhead Press: 30 kg x 5, 42.5 kg x 3, 57.5 kg x 1-2 before 72.5 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Sun	Overhead Press	72.5 kg	4	4	2-3 min	7-7.5	Direct strict press. If the last set exceeds the cap or bar path gets loose, repeat this load next week rather than forcing a jump.	
Sun	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	1	8	90 sec	7	sets of 8 balancing row set to support the shoulders without adding much fatigue the day before squats.	
Sun	Face Pull	RPE-selected load	1	12	45-60 sec	6-7	One clean shoulder-tissue set only; keep elbows high and motion crisp.	
END_WEEK1_TSV

Mon	One-Arm Pull-up	Bodyweight	3	1-2 per arm	150-240 sec	8-8.5	Same 3 attempt-sets. Goal is a cleaner singles on the weaker arm or both sides if week 1 stayed inside the cap; otherwise repeat week 1 standard. Week 2 advance: same set count as Week 1 - the progression is execution, not volume. Beat Week 1 by controlling the descent on every single and by closing the gap between your stronger and weaker side, at the same or lower RPE.	
Mon	Back Squat	177.5 kg	1	3	3-5 min	8	Only take this jump if week 1 stayed within cap and moved cleanly; otherwise repeat 175 kg.	
Mon	Back Squat	170 kg	2	3	3-4 min	7-7.5	Keep bar speed honest. Stop after 1 set if the top set already took more than planned.	
Mon	Push Press	RPE-selected load	3	3	2-3 min	7	Same dose. Only nudge load if week 1 stayed clearly submaximal and explosive.

Tue	Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	2	12	45-60 sec	7	Pause at the top and use full stretch for lower-leg tissue capacity.	
Thu	Run	Easy conversational pace	1	18 km	N/A	5-6	Long run. Hold the distance. Keep the same easy feel and keep it clearly below first threshold. Secondary endurance is held at the Week 1 tolerated dose so primary squat/One-Arm Pull-up progress and MMA recovery keep the recovery budget.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Bodyweight	2	15	30 sec	2	Low-cost support day. Keep the whole gym session crisp and cut the last row first if Friday MMA is especially hard.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.

If every prescribed rep was clean at or below the target RPE and elbows and forearms feel normal, beat week 2 through cleaner singles, lower RPE, or better left-right symmetry; skip any grind or elbow niggle.
